name: Read AI
tagline: Read AI is a meeting intelligence platform that records, transcribes, and summarises meetings while uniquely scoring participant engagement — measuring talk time, sentiment, and attention signals to surface who was most and least engaged. Its pre-meeting briefs pull CRM and calendar context, and post-meeting emails are auto-drafted with action items. Sales teams and managers use the engagement data to coach reps and improve how meetings run.
